generation_history.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: the EMPTY BOOKCASE for Captain Livé's pirate cabin, a four-view reconstruction sheet.

Image1 is the measured construction guide: keep its geometry, count of shelves, object positions, all four matching heights and the genuine narrow side views. Image2 is the approved captain's desk and controls only the dark warm walnut, amber edge wear and sculpted cartoon finish.

One tall, narrow, practical wooden bookcase. Simple straight thick sides, modest straight stepped top cap and bottom plinth, THREE fixed internal shelves making exactly FOUR EMPTY COMPARTMENTS. Each opening is backed by recessed dark walnut planks. These are real shelf recesses, not white through-holes, flat black panels or doors. Make the front edges of shelves and stiles solid, chunky and readable. The upper compartment accommodates a separate globe later. Keep the unit's top entirely bare.
Plain solid outer side panels. The actual back is uninterrupted vertical backing boards with a few broad nail heads; do not draw shelves, openings or front decoration on the back. One coherent construction in all views.
Finish: worn dark warm reddish walnut matching the approved desk, broad honey-brown chipped edges, sparse restrained wood grain and a few dents. Small practical fasteners, very restrained brass corner accents flush inside the existing contour. No gilded scrollwork, elaborate crest, curved decorative feet, fancy carvings or skulls.

Fixed upright pose in all four views. Strict level ORTHOGRAPHIC elevations from FRONT / LEFT / RIGHT / BACK. No perspective, no three-quarter angles, no camera tilt and no view from above. Cap and shelves are horizontal and seen edge-on. Full complete envelope0.90m wide×2.20m high×0.35m deep. Both front/back width-to-height0.4091, both side width-to-height0.1591. Keep the guide's identical height in every view within1px; do not make the narrow sides wider to fill the empty space. Preserve all four silhouettes and common baseline, painting bevels/outline inside them.
Neutral soft form shading. Clean cartoony cel-shaded pirate adventure art consistent with the desk, no photographic texture. Plain white background with generous vertical empty bands between the whole figures. No floor, cast shadow, labels, text, dimensions, borders or guide marks.
The object only: NO books, globe, lantern, maps, candles, bottles, drawers, cabinet doors, plants, curtains or other props. Exactly three internal shelves and four empty wood-backed recesses.
generation_history.rejection_reason: Heights839/837/839/840px produced a3px spread, exceeding the1px limit.

alignment_guide.purpose: New measured geometry guide only; imagegen will create final artwork.
alignment_guide.front_orientation: +Z toward room; Y up; ordinary standing orientation in every view
alignment_guide.guide_rendering: Flat vector geometry, 2 px outer strokes, no shadows, no labels.

read_only_cutter_measurement.source: Unmodified tools/crop_views.py imported read-only; full row, tolerance 18

alignment_guide.method: New measured primitive diagram; no existing raster art read or edited during construction.

assembly.method: Unchanged cutter crops native own-bounds rectangles, translating them into four common1037px cells. No resampling, per-view scaling or raster retouching.

object_scope.rule: Model the object only, never a dressed arrangement.
object_scope.contents: One empty solid-backed wooden shelf unit with thick straight side panels, three fixed internal shelves, flat cap/plinth and restrained attached brass corner fittings.

design.structure: Tall narrow practical walnut bookcase, with three straight internal shelves making exactly four empty compartments. Recesses have real shelf depth and a solid recessed plank back.
design.front: Four dark wooden-backed open bays with broad solid shelf edges, straight side stiles and a bare top.
design.sides: Genuinely narrow solid outer panels; these are depth profiles, not more views of the shelving face.
design.back: Uninterrupted vertical backing boards with small nail heads. Do not repeat the shelves as rear openings.
design.finish: Warm dark reddish walnut, broad honey-brown worn bevels, restrained grain/cracks and small practical brass corner caps contained within the simple rectangular outline.
design.openings: The front recesses end at opaque back boards and are not through-holes. No white background should replace the wooden backs.
design.wear_note: Fine painted cracks are surface wear, not an instruction to split the carcass or create structural holes.

reconstruction_orientation.axis_convention: Up +Y, width X, front/open shelving face +Z and rear -Z. Front camera +Z looks -Z; left -X looks +X; right +X looks -X; back -Z looks +Z.
reconstruction_orientation.engine_rotation: No reconstruction-pose correction. Final room position and yaw remain engine work.

placement.convention_status: Proposed upright dimensions and fitting cues only; no engine geometry or transform changed.
placement.origin: Floor-level center of the bottom plinth
placement.target_location: Left of the desk, matching docs/reference/room_target.png. Exact room coordinates and wall contact remain unassigned.

fit_cues_from_guide.status: Analytic guide parameters only; verify reconstructed shelf thickness, depth, openings and support surfaces before dressing.
fit_cues_from_guide.depth_limit: The guide carcass is 0.31 m deep before accounting for backing thickness, front setback and bevels. The proposed globe has a 0.30 m overall depth; do not infer usable shelf depth or guaranteed base support from the 0.35 m outer cap/plinth envelope.
fit_cues_from_guide.vertical_clearance_note: 0.46125 m guide bay height minus 0.38 m separate globe height gives 0.08125 m nominal clearance. This arithmetic does not verify either reconstructed mesh or final placement.

framing.projection: Level orthographic front, opposite side profiles and actual back
framing.camera: Horizontal optical axis at the unit midpoint, one orthographic scale, no pitch/roll, perspective or top-face peek.
framing.scale: All four source and final silhouettes are exactly 837 px high. The cutter translated native own-bounds rectangles into common canvases, with no resampling or per-view scaling.

validation.status: Complete source/final PNG, framing and empty shelf structure checked; reconstructed recess depth, globe clearance and engine placement remain unverified.
validation.method: Read-only full-row NumPy/Pillow measurements using unchanged crop_views.py modal_colour, ink_mask and find_figures at default tolerance 18 and default gap detection. Bounds are [x0,y0,x1,y1], upper bounds exclusive. Both PNGs fully decoded before measurement.
validation.foreground_threshold: Sum of absolute RGB distance from modal background exceeds 54.

visual_review.projection: Level cap/plinth and shelf edges; front/back widths match, both side profiles remain naturally narrow and equal in height.
visual_review.shelf_count: Exactly three internal shelves and four empty compartments.
visual_review.structure: Dark recessed backing is visible in the front; both outside panels are solid. Rear is a plain boarded panel with nail heads, not a duplicate shelf face.
visual_review.materials: Broad worn walnut bevels, restrained brass corners and simple readable construction consistent with the cabin props.
visual_review.isolation: No books, globe, lantern, drawer/door, wall, scenery, floor shadow or sheet text.

limitations: Overall size is a chosen new art target, not measured existing engine geometry.

Measured front/back width-to-height ratio is 0.412186 versus nominal 0.409091; side ratio is 0.164875 versus nominal 0.159091. At height 2.20 m these imply width 0.90681 m (+0.76%) and depth 0.36272 m (+3.64%). Check mesh proportions against dimensions_m rather than treating painted outlines as exact CAD.
Guide bay height, shelf thickness and internal width are proposed construction measurements, not confirmed output geometry. Real recess depth cannot be verified from the front raster alone.

The 0.08125 m nominal vertical allowance for the separate 0.38 m globe is guide arithmetic only. Backing thickness, shelf front setback and the globe base footprint still govern usable depth and support.
The wood shading and brass highlights are baked into this sheet and need review under room lighting.

pipeline.upload_note: Assign each Tripo upload slot by filename; sheet display order is not positional upload order.

target_triangles.source: HANDOFF.md furniture budget, not a measured reconstructed mesh.

pipeline.reconstruction_prompt_note: One solid-backed empty walnut bookcase, exactly three internal shelves and four deep open front recesses; solid outer side panels and real plain boarded rear. Do not flatten the shelving into a painted slab or remove the back to create through-holes.
pipeline.lighting_note: Source includes dark recess shading, broad warm wood highlights and brass bevel highlights. Use Tripo texture lighting removal and inspect the empty shelves under engine light.

pipeline.upscale_note: Native common canvases are already 1037 px square. Optional uniform 2x extraction adds no source detail. Preserve automatic own-bounds gap detection to avoid repadding existing cell margins.
pipeline.next_step: Reconstruct actual shelf recesses and solid back, verify the complete dimensions and usable shelf clearance, then place left of the desk. Add books/globe separately.
